desc: 秋叶焦糖纸感详情页，花朵绒面软窝十一镜从舒适主张到收口
leaf: 犬用花朵造型短毛绒软窝（八瓣环形窝体+可分离内垫+织纹窝底）
name: 犬用花朵造型可拆洗软窝款

shots.intent: 深焦糖整版加奶白标题与撕纸花边，一屏把「花朵软窝=舒适」的品类识别钉死
shots.textZone: 顶部两行奶白主标题带、其下一行短副标题位、右上花边小徽章一枚、左下一枚细线短杆标记

shots.intent: 把源图散在四格圆窗里的四条主张收成一屏四窗，一屏讲清为什么选它
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题带与一行 kicker 位，四枚圆窗下方各一行短标签位

shots.intent: 左栏裸地砖地与塌陷薄垫、右栏蓬起花朵窝，让买家先认领趴睡受凉的日常困扰
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题带与一行短说明位，两块面板各配一行短标签位

shots.intent: 真实居家一角里狗下巴搁进花瓣间小憩，把舒适交给画面而不靠口号
shots.textZone: 顶部一行主标题带与其下一行短副标题位

shots.intent: 正上方贴面微距加斜向擦光，把绒面密度与瓣缝褶痕拍成可核实的做工证据
shots.textZone: 上部主标题带与一行短说明位，右侧三枚引线胶囊标签位

shots.intent: 90 度正侧剖面把窝体与内垫分离的结构讲清，支撑可拆洗这一关键决策点
shots.textZone: 上部主标题带与一行短说明位，两支细线各一枚标签位

shots.intent: 同机位同光两块面板并置压平与回弹后的同一瓣体，把回弹讲成看得见的差异
shots.textZone: 两块面板各配一行状态标签与一行短说明位，顶部主标题带

shots.intent: 贴地极低角度掀拍窝底织纹，把防滑与离地防潮讲成一个可拍到的结构事实
shots.textZone: 底部主标题带与一行短说明位，右侧一枚引线标签位

shots.intent: 同一机位同一光把三档尺寸按真实比例排成一列，把「选哪档」一次解决
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题带与一行短副标题位，三枚单元下方各一行规格标签位

shots.intent: 把源图三行完全相同、彼此矛盾的参数表换成五行字段卡，用可核对结构消除最后顾虑
shots.textZone: 右栏五行字段标签与占位值，卡片上方主标题带与其下一行 kicker 位

shots.intent: 唯一一块深可可棕花边收口屏，用一行号召与一枚胶囊按钮替代源图装饰性店招带
shots.textZone: 右上两行主标题位、其下一行短说明位、右下圆角胶囊按钮位

style.backgroundSystem: flat autumn-caramel #DE9F45 poster screens carrying a scalloped torn-paper lower edge, milk-paper #FFF9EF rounded information cards at 20px corners sitting on the same caramel field, and exactly two real photographic home screens (the resting scene and the pain-point grid); the scalloped paper edge is the only recurring frame motif and its amplitude stays constant; one background treatment per screen, never a fourth background language
style.direction: warm autumn paper-cut pet-bedding detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: single-weight 2px thin-line pictograms in #4B3117 on card fields and in #FFF9EF on caramel fields, limited to one family: paw print, bone, ball of yarn and cloud puff, seated inside plain circles with no fill, plus the triple-wave rule in #C9552B as the only section ornament; no medical crosses, no thermometers, no mite or microbe illustrations, no seals, shields or medals
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused warm key from the upper left at 5200K with an even 5500K bounce fill, low contrast, gentle falloff, matte controlled highlights so the short pile reads as depth and layering rather than gloss, and always a real contact shadow under the nest so it rests under its own weight and never floats; the two real home screens use window light from the left at 5200K with a warm pool on the rug
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm autumn paper-cut pet-bedding ecommerce detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of autumn-caramel panel #DE9F45, milk-paper card #FFF9EF, deep cocoa-brown ink and closing block #4B3117, one butter-yellow accent #F5D95F pinned to the product pile, one persimmon-red accent #C9552B, one warm oat ledge #EAD6B8 and one caramel hairline #B8813C; warm tone throughout; one warm rounded humanist sans-serif family for Chinese and Latin with one headline weight per screen, Chinese display headline 30-44pt in #FFF9EF on caramel fields and in #4B3117 on card fields, a letter-spaced Latin kicker 11-13pt in #B8813C at most once per screen, section divider of one triple-wave rule in #C9552B, all copy as 「」 placeholders; background system of flat autumn-caramel poster screens carrying a scalloped torn-paper lower edge, milk-paper #FFF9EF rounded information cards at 20px corners on the same caramel field, and exactly two real photographic home screens, never a fourth background language; soft diffused warm key from the upper left at 5200K with an even 5500K bounce fill, low contrast, matte controlled highlights so the short pile reads as depth and not gloss, always a real contact shadow so the nest rests under its own weight; surfaces limited to matte warm oat limestone #EAD6B8, pale boucle rug and warm oat floor; infographic components limited to single-weight 2px thin-line paw, bone, yarn-ball and cloud-puff pictograms inside plain unfilled circles plus the triple-wave rule, no seals, shields, medals or clinical iconography; the nest held at one stable slight 3/4 or floor-level angle with constant scale, petal count and ring depth true to the reference, never restyled, recoloured or cropped mid-petal; any dog cropped, turned away or muzzle buried in the pile so no individual or breed reads, wearing no collar or accessory absent from the product reference; card corners fixed at 20px; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no brush or handwritten lettering, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no QR codes or store badges.
noDrift: no brush calligraphy, handwritten or cartoon lettering
no second scallop or torn-paper motif and no torn edge used more than once per screen
no glossy 3D icons, sparkle, steam, snowflake or mite illustrations
no off-palette props, toy colours or animal coats
no invented dimensions, weight limits, size counts, colour counts or season claims
no fabric composition, fibre percentage, grammage or washing temperature values
no efficacy, warmth, antibacterial, anti-mite or veterinary wording, no disease names
no certifications, test reports, lab numbers, ratings, awards or sales figures
no breed-identifiable animal face, no collar, harness or clothing on any animal
no QR codes, membership patches, prices, countdowns or store promotion overlays

palette.name: 深可可棕文字与收口块

style.presentationRules: the nest keeps one stable slight 3/4 or floor-level angle and a constant scale, petal count and ring depth across every screen, always grounded by its own contact shadow, its eight-petal silhouette, seam placement, pile direction, inner cushion and woven base band true to the reference and never restyled, recoloured or cropped mid-petal; card corners fixed at 20px; any dog appears cropped, turned away or with its muzzle buried in the pile so no individual reads as identifiable and no breed is recognisable, and it wears no collar, clothing or accessory absent from the product reference
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm oat limestone ledge #EAD6B8, pale boucle rug and warm oat floor inside the home screens; the petals always read as separate rounded stuffed pillows with visible seam puckering in butter-yellow #F5D95F pile, never flattened into a disc, never a tiled repeating pattern, never plastic-smoothed
style.typography: one warm rounded humanist sans-serif family for both Chinese and Latin; Chinese display headline 30-44pt in #FFF9EF on the caramel fields and in #4B3117 on the card fields; one letter-spaced Latin kicker 11-13pt in #B8813C used at most once per screen; section divider is one triple-wave rule in #C9552B; numbered reason blocks carry no badge, seal or medal; all rendered copy carried as 「」 placeholders
